nodes.summary: For continuous fitness `f`, a strategy absent at time `0` (`x_i(0) = 0`) stays absent for all `t ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Invariance of the faces of the simplex

nodes.summary: The total frequency `∑ x_i` evolves by `(∑ x_i)' = f̄(x) (1 - ∑ x_i)`.
nodes.title: Evolution of the total frequency under replicator dynamics

nodes.summary: If every strategy is present (`x i > 0`), then `x` is a rest point iff every strategy has fitness equal to the mean fitness.
nodes.title: Rest points in the interior are equalizers

nodes.summary: `x` is a rest point of the replicator equation: `x_i (f_i(x) - f̄(x)) = 0` for all `i`.
nodes.title: Rest point of the replicator equation

nodes.summary: `x` solves the replicator equation `x_i' = x_i (f_i(x) - f̄(x))` for all times `t ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Solution of the replicator equation

nodes.summary: The mean fitness `f̄(x) = ∑ i, x i * f x i` of the population state `x` for the fitness function `f`.
nodes.title: Mean fitness of a population state

nodes.summary: For continuous fitness `f`, a solution starting in the standard simplex (`x i ≥ 0` for all `i` and `∑ i, x i = 1`) stays in it for all `t ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Invariance of the simplex (Hofbauer–Sigmund 1998, §7.1)

nodes.summary: For continuous fitness `f`, a strategy with positive frequency at time `0` has positive frequency for all `t ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Present strategies stay present

nodes.summary: For continuous fitness `f`, a solution with `∑ x_i(0) = 1` satisfies `∑ x_i(t) = 1` for all `t ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Invariance of the simplex hyperplane

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
